notes.title: More Players, Screens and Controllers
notes.content:
Here are some of the key recent advancements:
[list][*]The split-screen player limit has now been increased to [b]eight players[/b]. [i]Although it is recommended to only have four players per screen.[/i]
[*]Space Fighter can now support an incredibly large range of controllers. For the full list see [i]first table[/i] [url=http://guavaman.com/projects/rewired/docs/SupportedControllers.html]here[/url]
[*]Using multiple screens is now supported. Even eight screens are supported. [/list]
